veranderings.voor: Ná sokkeroefening op Vrydagmiddag het Ruan
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans names the day-part without 'op' (as the lesson itself does later with 'Maandagmiddag by oefening'); leading with it reads more naturally.
The relative clause describes the past scene, so it needs the past tense like the rest of the sentence.
'met gevoude arms' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form; 'met sy arms gevou' reads like a translation.
One does not 'stand' a step closer; Afrikaans says 'n tree nader gee'.

veranderings.voor: Wat sê jy daar, is jy
veranderings.na: Wat sê jy daar? Is jy
veranderings.rede: Two separate questions are joined by a comma; a question mark between them is clearer.
The interjection 'Ag' is set off by a comma.

veranderings.voor: hoe sy gesig warm word tot by sy ore
veranderings.na: hoe sy gesig tot by sy ore warm word
veranderings.rede: In the subordinate clause the verb belongs at the end, after 'tot by sy ore'.

veranderings.voor: Sy hande het gebewe en hy
veranderings.na: Sy hande het gebewe, en hy
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs, so a comma goes before it.
'verbystap' is a separable verb that takes 'by iemand'; 'verby hulle stap' is an anglicised construction.
